## Introduction

Taha Hamdy is a Full-Stack Developer and Systems Architect with 3+ years of experience engineering high-performance SaaS platforms, distributed backend systems, and modern web applications. Based in Alexandria, Egypt, he works with clients and engineering teams worldwide.

- **Primary Focus**: SaaS Platforms, E-Commerce Systems, Distributed Architectures, Real-Time Messaging.
- **Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, HTML5, CSS3.
- **Frameworks**: Next.js 16 (Turbopack, App Router), React 19, NestJS, Node.js, Express.
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB.
- **Website**: [https://taha-hamdy.vercel.app](https://taha-hamdy.vercel.app)
- **GitHub**: [https://github.com/TahaHamdy-MernDev](https://github.com/TahaHamdy-MernDev)

## Key Systems & Case Studies

### 1. Egapy ERP
- **Website**: [https://www.egapy.com/ar](https://www.egapy.com/ar)
- **Role**: Full-Stack Developer (Team of 2)
- **Status**: Live Product in Production
- **Description**: Enterprise Resource Planning solution designed to help businesses of all sizes streamline operations, manage multi-branch inventory, handle invoicing, and monitor business analytics.
- **Architecture**: Next.js (App Router) + NestJS + PostgreSQL + Prisma.
- **Key Features**: Multi-tenant authorization, real-time inventory ledger, automated PDF invoicing, audit logging.

### 2. Labaik Umrah Platform
- **Website**: [https://labaikapp.com/ar](https://labaikapp.com/ar)
- **Role**: Full-Stack Developer (Solo)
- **Status**: Live Landing & Private Administrative Dashboard
- **Description**: A platform that facilitates "Umrah al-Badal" by connecting individuals with verified delegates who perform Umrah on behalf of loved ones (elderly, ill, or deceased).
- **Architecture**: Next.js + NestJS + MySQL + TypeORM + BullMQ + FCM + Sockets.
- **Key Features**: Live landing site, private admin dashboard, mobile app backend API, push notification queues.

### 3. Nazam Commerce Platform
- **Repository**: [https://github.com/TahaHamdy-MernDev/nazam](https://github.com/TahaHamdy-MernDev/nazam)
- **Role**: Full-Stack Developer (Solo)
- **Status**: Private Repository
- **Description**: Commerce-operations platform unifying multi-channel inventory, automated catalog synchronization, and distributed order processing.
- **Architecture**: Next.js + NestJS + Turborepo + Prisma + PostgreSQL + Redis + BullMQ.

### 4. Buy From Egypt
- **Repository**: [https://github.com/TahaHamdy-MernDev](https://github.com/TahaHamdy-MernDev)

- **Website**: [https://ecombo.co/ar](https://ecombo.co/ar)

- **Technologies**: React.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Responsive UI.

## Technical Architecture & Stack Matrix

### Layer 1: Client & User Interface
- **Core Technologies**: React 19, Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4.
- **Animation & Motion**: GSAP (GreenSock), Framer Motion, CSS Transforms.
- **Internationalization**: next-intl with full Arabic (RTL) & English (LTR) bidirectional rendering.
- **State & Data Fetching**: TanStack Query, React Server Components (RSC), Server Actions.

### Layer 2: API & Application Services
- **Core Frameworks**: NestJS, Node.js, Express.
- **APIs**: RESTful APIs, GraphQL (Apollo/Yoga), WebSockets (Socket.IO).
- **Background Jobs & Queues**: BullMQ, Redis-backed workers, cron schedulers.
- **Authentication**: JWT, Session Management, OAuth2, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

### Layer 3: Data & Persistence
- **Relational Databases**: PostgreSQL, MySQL.
- **ORMs & Query Builders**: Prisma ORM, TypeORM, Drizzle ORM.
- **Caching & Key-Value**: Redis (In-memory caching, rate-limiting, PubSub messaging).
- **NoSQL**: MongoDB, Mongoose.

### Layer 4: Infrastructure & DevOps
- **Containerization**: Docker, Docker Compose.
- **Deployment & Hosting**: Vercel, Railway, DigitalOcean, VPS Linux Server Setup.
- **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions automated linting, testing, and deployment pipelines.
- **Tooling**: Biome, Turborepo, TypeScript Compiler, Turbopack.

---

## Engineering Methodology & Lifecycle

1. **Stage 01 // Blueprint & Topology**: Deconstructing requirements into data models, API contracts, and architecture diagrams.
2. **Stage 02 // Core Foundation**: Establishing database migrations, auth middleware, and validation schemas.
3. **Stage 03 // Production Assembly**: Building optimized user interfaces and connecting business logic.
4. **Stage 04 // Hardening & Telemetry**: Profiling query performance, caching frequently accessed resources, and ensuring 99.9% uptime.
